name: TAFE Queensland fee concession (subsidised courses)
summary: Students in government-subsidised qualifications may get a concession on tuition fees if they meet eligibility rules.
who: Enrolled in a government-subsidised qualification and meet the concession eligibility requirements (not listed on the page).
how: Apply for the concession as you enrol.
catches: Eligibility requirements are not set out on the policy page; ask TAFE Queensland.

evidence.quote: If you are undertaking government-subsidised qualifications, TAFE Queensland may offer you a fee concession
Fee concessions must be applied for and approved as you enrol.
